level.label: representation.text.word
level.why: A closed set of one level name, 'code'. Inferred, finetype also reads it as a word; nominated so the label does not move with the inference's confidence on a single repeated value.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: CMS's quarter and the file's date, such as 2026-10/2026-09-23: an identifier for the snapshot. Inferred it is `unknown`; it is not a date, since the quarter in front is CMS's release.

text_source.label: representation.text.word
text_source.why: A closed set of two values, cms and cms_cpt_redacted. Inferred, finetype labels it a software version, which it is not; each value is one word-like token.

action_code.label: representation.text.word
action_code.why: CMS's one-letter action codes (A, B, C, D, F, N, P, R, S, T). Inferred, finetype labels the column a boolean from initials and the descriptor would type it boolean, which would lose every code but two; it is a closed set of letters.

asc_payment_group.label: representation.text.word
asc_payment_group.why: YY or NULL, CMS's ambulatory surgical center indicator. Inferred it is `unknown`; the value is one short token.
